items.markdown:
![Ultimate Koh Samui Beach Guide](https://api.dataforseo.com/cdn/i/07262316-1672-0139-0000-7e9ad27d7855:4)
The best beaches in Koh Samui are [Chaweng Beach](https://www.tripadvisor.co.uk/Attractions-g293918-Activities-c61-t52-Ko_Samui_Surat_Thani_Province.html), [Silver Beach](https://northabroad.com/8-best-beaches-koh-samui-thailand/) , and [Maenam Beach](https://www.saiihotels.com/best-beaches-in-koh-samui-where-to-swim-sunbathe-and-stay/) , each offering a totally different style of island experience.[[1]](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=lZrWVmacZ2o)

Vibrant & Action-Packed

- **Chaweng Beach:** The island's longest and most famous white-sand beach. It features turquoise water, vibrant nightlife, beach clubs, and water sports.
- **Chaweng Noi:** Located just south of Chaweng, this smaller cove offers softer sand, clearer water, and a slightly calmer vibe while staying close to the action.[](https://northabroad.com/8-best-beaches-koh-samui-thailand/) [[1]](https://northabroad.com/8-best-beaches-koh-samui-thailand/)[[2]](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=eGzbyXRSWXI&t=4)

Scenic & Great for Snorkeling

- **Silver Beach (Crystal Bay):** A tiny, picturesque cove tucked between large granite boulders. It boasts crystal-clear water and colorful marine life, making it premier for snorkeling.
- **Lamai Beach:** Quieter than Chaweng with a relaxed atmosphere, fine sand, and plenty of nearby restaurants.[](https://northabroad.com/8-best-beaches-koh-samui-thailand/) [[1]](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=lZrWVmacZ2o)[[2]](https://thailandmagazine.com/koh-samui/beaches/)[[3]](https://www.garrya.com/en/destinations/samui/experiences/8-best-most-beautiful-beaches-koh-samui-thailand)

Peaceful & Family-Friendly

- **Maenam Beach:** A tranquil 7-kilometer stretch of golden sand on the north coast backed by palm trees, ideal for quiet walks and deep relaxation.
- **Choeng Mon Beach:** A calm, sheltered bay in the northeast with shallow, warm waters that are very safe for children.
- **Lipa Noi Beach:** Famous for its shallow, rock-free waters and incredible sunset views on the west coast.[](https://northabroad.com/8-best-beaches-koh-samui-thailand/) [[1]](https://www.saiihotels.com/best-beaches-in-koh-samui-where-to-swim-sunbathe-and-stay/)[[2]](https://www.telegraph.co.uk/travel/destinations/asia/thailand/koh-samui/best-beaches-koh-samui/)[[3]](https://www.instagram.com/reel/DX32vn5haxd/?hl=en)
